digest_title: SOFC x AI Data Centers - Daily Digest 2026-07-14

top_signals.headline: Crossroads Capital deepens supply-wall thesis; BE ends session higher
top_signals.summary: Second Crossroads Capital short report ('Situational Awareness Collides with Physical Awareness') claims Bloom's scandium usage exceeds non-Chinese supply by 20+ tons. Bloom denied via SEC 8-K. Despite ~15% five-session decline, BE ended July 14 higher -- short fatigue with Q2 earnings 14 days out (July 28 AH).

top_signals.headline: Valar Atomics + Nvidia: Ward250 nuclear reactor powers Blackwell AI chip; 30 MW Utah data center (first appearance)
top_signals.summary: Announced July 1. Ward250 (100 kW, achieved criticality June 18) powered an Nvidia Blackwell GPU -- claimed first startup-built nuclear reactor to power an AI chip. Partnership on 30 MW near-zero-water Utah data center. 100 kW is 4-5 orders of magnitude below data center scale; full site is multi-year.

top_signals.headline: GE Vernova + Blue Energy: 2.5 GW gas-plus-nuclear Texas hybrid plant -- gas from 2030, nuclear from 2032 (first appearance)
top_signals.summary: Announced May 5, 2026. ~1 GW GE 7HA.02 gas turbines (2030) + ~1.5 GW BWRX-300 SMRs (2032) for AI data center power in Texas. First 'gas-bridge-to-nuclear' competing architecture. Beyond 2026-2028 SOFC window but introduces new 2028-2032 planning template.
